item.title: security-guidance: use the CA file macOS ships when Python has none
item.description: A python.org Python on macOS has no CA certificates until its "Install Certificates" command is run, so every review from it failed to verify the API's certificate. Where Python's default TLS context holds no certificate at all, the plugin now adds /etc/ssl/cert.pem, the file Apple's own Python uses
